title: VietIRRDocumentManifestRecord
description: Schema for a single document entry in the VietIRR-RAG corpus manifest.

doc_id.description: Unique canonical identifier for the document.

document_title.description: Official title or descriptor of the document.

issuing_organization.description: Governmental or technical body that promulgated the document.

document_type.description: Classification: Technical Report, Operating Procedure, Decision, Plan, Notice.

publication_year.description: Year of issuance (4 digits or UNKNOWN).

page_count.description: Total number of pages in the source document.

file_size_bytes.description: Physical size of the source PDF in bytes.

sha256.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of the authentic PDF file.

source_url.description: Canonical public URL where the document was published.

corpus_layer.description: Corpus cohort layer indicating baseline or expansion version.

access_status.description: Public availability status at source agency.

text_evidence_count.description: Count of text evidence blocks extracted.

table_evidence_count.description: Count of table evidence blocks extracted.

total_evidence_count.description: Total evidence units derived from this document.
